metadata.title: Diagnose execution failures

applicability.scope: Run-specific failure reproduction, fault isolation and regression verification.
applicability.input_contract: Actual hardware, model, engine, script and flags, benchmark, acceptance criteria, current diagnosis, permitted changes and budget.
applicability.produced_artifact: Minimal reproducer, passing control, localized cause and verified original-script replay.
applicability.refusal_point: Record missing evidence or an exhausted search budget and identify the smallest discriminating test before declaring success.

limitations: The cards describe routes and acceptance evidence; hardware support and task success require separate validation.

body.json.text:
{
  "task": "debug",
  "title": "Diagnose execution failures",
  "choose_when": "A hang, crash, OOM or execution-path failure needs a reproducible cause.",
  "required_inputs": [
    "symptom, phase and logs",
    "minimal reproducer",
    "last working version or configuration",
    "hardware and system context"
  ],
  "steps": [
    "Reduce to a failing and a working control.",
    "Localize the first failing boundary and test competing causes.",
    "Verify the fix against the reproducer and an unaffected control."
  ],
  "acceptance_evidence": "A minimal reproducer, cause with evidence and regression check.",

    "inference-optimization-casebook",
